taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-13, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1340.2 | 1.08 | 1.08
2 | 2148.3 | 1.38 | 2.46
3 | 5322.7 | 1.26 | 3.72
4 | 18475.7 | 0.33 | 4.05
5 | 19320.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as A-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-13, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Station T-13, Survey Area T**

The interpreted layer model shows five layers with resistivity increasing monotonically with depth: 1340.2 Ω·m (Layer 1, 0–1.08 m), 2148.3 Ω·m (Layer 2, 1.08–2.46 m), 5322.7 Ω·m (Layer 3, 2.46–3.72 m), 18475.7 Ω·m (Layer 4, 3.72–4.05 m), and 19320.3 Ω·m (Layer 5, basement, no lower boundary defined). 

Applying the standard curve-type convention to each triplet of successive layers: Layers 1-2-3 give r1<r2<r3 (A), Layers 2-3-4 give r2<r3<r4 (A), and Layers 3-4-5 give r3<r4<r5 (A). All three triplets yield the same letter, so the curve reduces to a single-letter designation, A-type, consistent with continuously increasing resistivity with depth (typical of a resistive basement sequence).

This matches the on-file classification of A-type for this station. No discrepancy was found between the computed curve type and the filed label.

{"curve_type_stated": "A", "label_issue_flagged": false}
